platform: other:knowink-totalresults (new React site with a JSON API at api.resultsnd.sos.nd.gov; the JS bundle calls it 'totalResultsBaseUrl'. It replaced the old BPro TotalVote site results.sos.nd.gov, which still shows the 2024 general.)

feeds.what: vote counts for every contest of the election (531), with a per-location breakdown, keyed by contest id and choice id. NO names in it.
feeds.notes: Leaving contestType off returns everything (response.contestType comes back "_ALL_"). The site itself asks per type: &contestType=SW (12 statewide contests with all 53 counties each, saved as ContestResults-SW.json, 310469 bytes) or LEG (51, saved as ContestResults-LEG.json, 84967 bytes); other codes JUD, CW, CON, MUN, SCH. Envelope: versionID "v876", lastUpdated, isOfficial, turnout, response.contests[].

feeds.what: names: every contest's title, type code, vote-for, and its choices (name, partyID, order) keyed by the same ids
feeds.notes: Must be joined to GetContestResults: results.contests[].contestID -> searchList response.contests[<id>].contestName; results choices[].choiceID -> contests[<id>].choices[<choiceID>].name. Note the parameter is spelled cid here and cId elsewhere (both lower/upper seen in the site's own calls).

feeds.what: election info: name, date, parties, contest types, locations; plus statewide turnout and precincts

feeds.notes: Other calls the page makes, not saved: /Client/GetClientConfig?cId=north-dakota, /Client/GetLanguageConfig?cId=north-dakota, /Turnout/GetTurnout?cId=north-dakota&electionID=348.

election_id: 348 (electionID query parameter; also the page fragment #election=348). Client id cId=north-dakota.
discovery: GET https://api.resultsnd.sos.nd.gov/Election/GetElectionList?cid=north-dakota : the entry with isDefault true is the current election. Only elections on the new site are listed (348 general, 346 primary); older ones are on results.sos.nd.gov.
bot_blocking: None seen: the relay User-Agent got 200 on every call (Cloudflare in front, cf-cache-status DYNAMIC, no challenge; it sets __cf_bm and ARRAffinity cookies, which were not needed). CAVEAT about this machine only: Git Bash curl 8.8.0 (Schannel) fails on every *.sos.nd.gov host with 'curl: (43) A libcurl function was given a bad argument' after a TLS renegotiation, with either User-Agent, so the files and .headers.txt here were fetched with Python urllib sending the same relay User-Agent and Origin header (headers file written by the script, not curl -D). Headless Chrome also loads the API fine. Browser User-Agent not needed.
updated_field: Envelope field lastUpdated = "2026-11-10T23:21:28.7881788Z" (UTC, ISO 8601 with Z) and versionID "v876", on GetContestResults, GetContestSearchList and GetElectionInfo.
reporting_field: Per contest (and per location inside it): precinctsReporting, precinctsPartiallyReporting, totalPrecincts, e.g. 358 / 0 / 358. Statewide in the envelope: turnout {"registeredVoters":600394,"precinctsReporting":358,"precinctsPartiallyReporting":0,"totalPrecincts":358,"totalBallotsCast":239057,"reportingPercent":100,"votePercent":39.82}.

us_house: Representative in Congress (at large: one seat, no district number)
other_statewide: Superintendent of Public Instruction Unexpired 2-Year Term
measures: Constitutional Measure No. 1 relating to the threshold for approving a constitutional amendment from a simple majority to sixty percent
Initiated Constitutional Measure No. 2 relating to funding of school lunches

choice_format: Names live only in GetContestSearchList, padded and double-spaced: {"id":"37665","name":"Julie  Fedorchak ","partyID":"REP","order":1} (trailing space, two spaces between first and last name). Party is a separate code (REP, DEM = Democratic-NPL, IND, LIB, NON; names in ElectionInfo.response.parties). Write-in is "  write-in " with partyID NON, id 9901. Measures: choices "Yes " (id 9001) and "No " (id 9002) with partyID "" in the search list and "   " (three spaces) in results. Counts are in GetContestResults: {"choiceID":"37386","totalVotes":146373,"partyID":"REP","votePercent":62.74,"isWinner":false}.
district_field: Both. Title has it zero-padded ("State Senator District 01"), and GetContestResults has a separate districtID ("01", "37") on legislative contests; on local contests districtID holds a place name ("Harwood"), and it is "" on statewide ones. contestTypeCode (SW, LEG, JUD, CW, CON, MUN, SCH) is in the search list. Only odd-numbered legislative districts are up in 2026; State Representative contests are vote-for-2.
